summary: End-to-end tested the 4 new features (Player Portal, Finals bracket, Email confirmations, CSV export) + clarifications (Oct 31 early-bird, moderator confirm/edit, monthly rewards). Extended backend_test.py with 14 new pytest tests covering /players/lookup, /players/submit-match, /admin/matches/{id}/confirm, PUT /admin/matches/{id} (edit + recompute), /admin/matches/export, /rewards + /admin/rewards/{month}. Fixed 2 stale assertions from iteration 1 (early_cutoff 2026-10-31, public /players redacted). Ran full 29-test suite in parallel: 29/29 passed (100%). Browser-tested Portal, Finals and Admin flows against the public URL with an admin session cookie: portal lookup + submit-match success toast, finals bracket + crown-champion celebration, admin Match Log confirm/edit/export, admin Rewards save, Home monthly rewards + Oct 31 hero copy — all working.

issues: React hydration warning in console: <span> inside <option> — comes from the Emergent visual-editor overlay wrapping <option> children (data-ve-dynamic attributes). Cosmetic devtools warning only, does not affect the UI or tests.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 803 lines and starting to be busy — consider splitting routers (auth, players, matches, admin, email) into modules for maintainability. Not blocking.

compute_standings filter uses {'confirmed': {'$ne': False}} — this correctly excludes pending player-submitted matches while still counting seeded/admin matches (which may have confirmed omitted or true). Verified working, but consider explicitly setting confirmed=True on all admin/seed matches (already done) and using {'confirmed': True} for stricter intent.

send_welcome_email failures are swallowed (logger.error) which is correct so registration isn't blocked; verified backend logs show 202 Accepted from Emergent Resend, no 'Welcome email failed' entries.
Admin.jsx (419 lines) is still within limit but nearing threshold; further tabs will justify a split.
